title: New Era Season 3
description: This the modpack used on New Era SMP Season 3 server.
body:
![New Era Season 3 Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12f5d1c9dc4c811bad16004cba347435eac9cfdc.webp)
---
This pack aims to improve minecrafts visuals while also having good performance and enhancing the gameplay with some Vanilla+ Features.

This Vanilla+ pack is aimed to make multiplayer more fun and enjoyable. It also tries to keep that vanilla feel while also keeping it fresh and new.

Gameplay Features include Backpacks, More Structures, More Nether Biomes, Natural Generated Armor Trims

Please Enjoy!
